title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels (borrowed by Peter Kafer) > Will Boswell's reel @ 7 1/2 ips; Transfer Info: Reel (Technics RS1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of an epic acoustic‑driven show, highlighted by a soaring Not Fade Away and the moving "To Lay Me Down".
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this performance, noting the acoustic first set as a treat and praising Set 2 for its “gr8 stuff,” with Not Fade Away singled out as a highlight. The recording is described as sounding excellent with no apparent flaws, making it an especially enjoyable listen for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are highly positive about the musical performance and describe the soundboard recording as excellent; with only two detailed reviews confidence is medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear soundboard capture with no reported dropouts or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic first set is described as a treat, followed by a second set full of “gr8 stuff,” indicating a strong and well‑balanced flow.
